design: Round 1: query real GRWT100 (E3) for the 18 highest E1-ranked model lines plus 6 stratified control lines spanning model ranks 61,181,361,541,721,891 (0-indexed). Round 2: query the next 6 highest E1-ranked lines (model ranks 19-24) after revising on Round-1 measured values. Total 30 oracle queries. Compare measured values of top-E1 lines vs controls and compute Spearman(E1 rank, E3 value) over phenotyped lines (E2).
observation_metric: measured GRWT100 of top-18 E1 lines vs 6 stratified controls; Spearman(E1 rank, E3 measured) over the 24 phenotyped lines; fraction of top-E1 lines above the 75th-percentile boundary bracketed from E3
refutation_condition: Top-E1 lines' measured GRWT100 are not higher than controls, OR Spearman(E1 rank, E3 measured) <= 0 over phenotyped lines
